experiences.description:
•	Producing & presenting weather forecasts to large audiences of mixed knowledge levels.
•	Presenting to the media (TV & Radio) to give additional & interesting information to the general public.
•	Training new graduates mentoring them through their qualification process.		
•	Fulfilling numerous leadership roles including; Team Manager (taking on all aspects of people and process management within the forecasting team) and Forecasting Shift Team Leader (with overall responsibility of a broader range of customers across the South of the UK).

•	Interim Met Office Senior Management post.
Responsible for identifying areas where new Met Office capability could improve weather forecasting services.
•	Identified aspects within existing services where additional Met Office services can provide an operational and business benefit.
•	Managed all aspects of change brought about by the development of new or improved services.
•	Managed small-medium sized projects & project teams consisting of; IT Practitioners, Modellers & Developers, Meteorologists and Earth Scientists, in order to facilitate these changes and improvements.
•	Led stakeholder management & relationship strategy allowing for widespread support of change and development.
•	Engaged with senior decision makers and Met Office heads during decision making processes.
•	Directed a working group of several senior Met Office employees to achieve detailed customer requirements gathering and solution finding, utilising continually developing Met Office computing capability.
•	Resolved internal Met Office and external customer conflict, brought about by major change, through negotiation and compromise.
•	Delivered presentations to potential customers showcasing the Met Office capability.
•	Successfully oversaw projects which allowed for the growth & development of Met Office services.

•	Assistant store manager (Mar 2011-Mar 2012); oversaw all aspects of the running of the store, including tracking individual and team sales targets and implementing strategies to meet them.
•	Sales colleague (Oct 2006-Mar 2011); provided customer service to the general public by determining their requirements and finding solutions to meet and exceed their needs. Responsible for monitoring own individual progress against targets adapting strategies where necessary to exceed them.
